newsitem.title: USA: Waban Inc prepares for BJ's spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Waban Inc prepares for BJ's spinoff.

text.p: Waban Inc said Tuesday it filed preliminary proxy materials with the Securities and Exchange Commission in connection with the planned spinoff of BJ's Wholesale Club division to stockholders.
The materials are available via the SEC's Edgar system, the company said, and by request from the company.
Waban said it expects to mail definitive proxy materials to its stockholders in December.
The company also said it asked the Internal Revenue Service for a letter ruling the planned spinoff will be tax-free to the company and its stockholders.
